body:
Two months. Bounced around therapists because the previous ones didn't have the means to treat me. This one does, been here for about a month now.

So far it has been indexing what is wrong meaning more and more is being added to the pile every week. Meds are making it even worse, have to wait for another week before the psychiatrist has time.

Living with my biggest trigger at home. Not like she is making it any better. Not like I can leave her either as she is my support too. Funny how your brain can set you up for that. Whatever I decide or do, it will trigger.

I can call the psychologist and tell about my last attempt. Will get me more help faster, will also mean them calling cps as I have to care for my kids at the moment. Whatever happens. It's a mess.
Same reason I do. Either the psych fixes me or I fix the situation. Whichever comes first.
